description_en: Consultation transfer refers to transferring a call to another agent, a skill group queue, or an external number. It is also known as follow transfer or two-step transfer
description_zh: 咨询转接通话到其他坐席或某个技能组队列或外部号码，咨询转接也叫关注转或双步转
kebab_example: aliyun ccc initiate-attended-transfer --instance-id ccc-test --transferee agent2@ccc-test --job-id job-65382141036850000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InitiateAttendedTransfer

parameters.help_en: The agent ID initiating the consultation transfer
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The party initiating the transfer. When transferring to an external number, this parameter specifies the caller number. This parameter is invalid when transferring to an internal agent or skill group; in such cases, the initiator is determined by the UserId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 转接发起方，当场景是咨询转接到外部号码时，用此参数指定的号码作为主叫，转内部坐席或技能组时，此参数无效，发起方由UserId指定
parameters.name: transferor

parameters.help_en: The transferee, which can be an agent ID or a skill group ID
parameters.help_zh: 被转接方，可以是坐席ID或技能组ID
parameters.name: transferee

parameters.help_en: Timeout duration for the consultation transfer, in seconds. If the transferee does not answer within the specified time, the call is disconnected. This field is optional. Default value is 30 seconds
parameters.help_zh: 咨询转接超时时间，超过指定时间被转接方没有接起通话，则挂断通话，此字段选填，默认30，单位秒
parameters.name: timeout_seconds

parameters.help_en: The queuing priority when transferring to a skill group queue. Valid values range from 0 to 9, where 0 is the highest priority and 9 is the lowest
parameters.help_zh: 转接到技能组队列时的排队优先级，取值范围0-9，0优先级最高，9最低
parameters.name: call_priority

parameters.help_en: The policy name for agent assignment when transferring to a skill group queue
parameters.help_zh: 转接到技能组队列时的座席分配策略名称
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.help_en: The policy parameters for agent assignment when transferring to a skill group queue
parameters.help_zh: 转接到技能组队列时的座席分配策略参数
parameters.name: strategy_params

parameters.help_en: The destination type for the transfer. Valid values are AGENT, SKILL_GROUP, and EXTERNAL. If this parameter is not provided, the system determines the destination type based on the format of the target number. If inaccurate detection occurs, explicitly specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 转接目的类型，可选值为AGENT，SKILL_GROUP和EXTERNAL。如果此参数不传，则系统会根据转接的目标号码的格式进行判断，如果发现有判不准确的情况，则需要指定此参数
parameters.name: transferee_type

parameters.help_en: The call assignment type. Valid values are Automatic or Manual. If this parameter is empty, the default value is Automatic, which is also the current system's default behavior. When Manual is selected, you must invoke APIs such as ClaimCall to assign the call to a specific agent
parameters.help_zh: 话务分配类型，可选参数为自动分配(Automatic)或者手动分配(Manual)。如果此参数为空，则默认为自动分配的方式，这也是当前系统的默认行为。选择手动分配方式时，需要您自己配合调用ClaimCall等接口把电话分给指定的座席
parameters.name: routing_type

parameters.help_en: Ingest endpoint data, primarily used for extension requirements. Regular users do not need to concern themselves with this
parameters.help_zh: 随路数据，主要用于扩展需求，普通用户无需关心
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The queuing timeout period in seconds when the transfer target is a skill group queue
parameters.help_zh: 当转接目标是技能组队列时排队超时时间，单位为秒
parameters.name: queuing_timeout_seconds

parameters.help_en: The queuing overflow threshold when the transfer target is a skill group queue. The default value is 0, which means no overflow occurs
parameters.help_zh: 当转接目标是技能组队列时排队溢出阈值。默认值为0，表示不溢出
parameters.name: queuing_overflow_threshold

CallType.description_en: The call type of the call channel

ChannelState.description_en: The status of the call channel

Destination.description_en: The callee of the call channel

Index.description_en: Records the order in which this channel was created during the call
Index.description_zh: 记录这个Channel在通话过程中创建的顺序

ReleaseInitiator.description_en: The party that initiated the release of the call channel, indicating who hung up first
ReleaseInitiator.description_zh: 话务通道的挂断方，表示该话务通道是谁首先发起的挂断

ReleaseReason.description_en: The hang-up reason for the voice channel, indicating why the current voice channel was disconnected. The value comes from the response codes defined in the SIP protocol. Customers should refer to the SIP protocol to analyze the hang-up reason
ReleaseReason.description_zh: 话务通道的挂断原因，表示当前话务通道为什么会被挂断，取值来自SIP协议中定义的响应码，请客户参考SIP协议分析挂断原因

SkillGroupId.description_en: The skill group ID associated with the voice channel. In inbound scenarios, the associated skill group ID is determined by the agent transfer module configured in the IVR. In outbound scenarios, the associated skill group ID is the first skill group the agent signed into
SkillGroupId.description_zh: 话务通道关联的技能组ID，呼入场景下，关联的技能组ID由IVR中转人工模块配置的技能组决定，呼出场景下，关联的技能组ID为座席签入的第一个技能组的ID

Timestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp of the most recent status change of the voice channel, in milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 话务通道最近一次状态变化的时间戳，格式是Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

UserExtension.description_en: The extension number of the agent associated with the channel
UserExtension.description_zh: 话务通道关联的坐席的分机号

UserId.description_en: The agent ID associated with the channel. This field is empty for a Customer channel
UserId.description_zh: 话务通道关联的坐席ID，如果是客户的话务通道，该字段为空

ContextId.description_en: System auto increment ID. Customers do not need to concern themselves with this field
ContextId.description_zh: 系统自增ID，客户无需关心

BreakCode.description_en: Break status code, which can be either System-defined or Custom-defined. System-defined break codes include: Warm-up (temporary break state after an agent is published and before becoming idle), RingingTimeout (break caused by agent ringing timeout), and RejectCall (break caused by agent call rejection). There are no restrictions on Custom-defined status codes; customers can define them as needed for their business
BreakCode.description_zh: 小休状态码，分为系统定义的和客户定义的两种，系统定义的小休吗包括：Warm-up （坐席上线后置闲前的临时小休状态）、RingingTimeout（坐席振铃超时导致的小休）、RejectCall（坐席拒接导致的小休）。客户自定义状态码没有限制，客户可以根据业务需要自行定义

enumValueTitles.RingingTimeout: 坐席振铃超时导致的小休
enumValueTitles.Warm-up: 坐席上线后置闲前的临时小休状态

DeviceId.description_en: Device ID, the identity ID of a browser-based Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC) softphone or a physical phone device. Only one type of device can be registered at a time
DeviceId.description_zh: 设备ID，浏览器WebRTC软电话或实体话机设备的标识ID，同一时间只允许一种设备注册

Heartbeat.description_en: The time when the last heartbeat was received from the agent, in UNIX timestamp format with millisecond precision
Heartbeat.description_zh: 上次收到坐席心跳的时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

OutboundScenario.description_en: Indicates whether the agent is in outbound-only mode
OutboundScenario.description_zh: 坐席是否处于仅外呼模式

Reserved.description_en: The most recent time when the agent was reserved. Being reserved means an incoming call will be assigned to the agent shortly. The value is formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
Reserved.description_zh: 坐席最近一次被预定的时间，被预定意味着马上将有来电分配给该坐席，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

SignedSkillGroupIdList.description_en: List of skill group IDs that the agent has signed into
SignedSkillGroupIdList.description_zh: 坐席签入的技能组ID列表
